pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-343 was wet clean with wall buildup removed and 5 dummy wafers seasoning, pre-PM recipe time 61.7 s, baseline clean chamber time 60.0 s, target 500.0 A, control limits 493.0 to 507.0 A, spec limits 485.0 to 515.0 A.
Metrology matching on reference wafer 500.0 A: MET01 reads 499.95 A, MET02 reads 499.97 A, MET02 minus MET01 0.02 A checked 16.2 hours ago, so no offset needed.

End of previous cycle mean thickness 504.02 A, earlier wet clean with seasoning had first wafers vs later 0.08 A and slope -0.05 A per lot, while wet clean with skipped seasoning had -7.14 A and slope -0.07 A per lot, so seasoning was adequate and no ongoing drift expected.
Estimate from monitors 1 and 2 gives rate 8.2695 A per s and recipe time 60.46 s, change -2.0% vs pre-PM, pre-PM time would give 510.23 A.
Monitor 3 verification at time 60.46 s gave thickness 500.3 A with implied rate 8.2748 A per s on runs since PM 3, confirming on-target within control.
Final estimate using monitors 1, 2, 3 gives rate 8.2713 A per s and recipe time 60.45 s, change -2.03% vs pre-PM, pre-PM time would give 510.34 A.

release.summary: Chamber needed new rate after wet clean. Two monitors at 60.0 s both gave 496.17 A estimating 60.46 s for 500 A. Verification at 60.46 s gave 500.3 A. Final recipe 60.45 s, -2.03% from pre-PM, EWMA 0.3 with no drift as wet cleans with seasoning show flat slope.
